page.title: Org
page.empty_description: A structure decides who works on what: it routes issues to units, escalates, approves and spends. Pick one of the seven models to start.
page.read_only_role: Only a workspace owner or admin can change this organization.

new.description: Choose where it applies, then the model it follows. You can edit the definition afterwards.
new.workspace_default: Workspace default (every project without its own)

wizard.title: Create an organisation

purpose.question: What is this team here to do?
purpose.help: One sentence. Its words name the structure and become what each unit picks up.
purpose.label: In one sentence
purpose.placeholder: Answer our customers' tickets within the day.

flow.question: How does the work move?
flow.decider: When a request arrives, who decides in the end?
flow.decider_each_team: Each team, for its own area
flow.shape: Teams by project, by role, or both?
flow.taskforce_termination_hint: Choose an end date or an end condition.

model_line.hierarchy: A clear chain: every team knows who to escalate to.
model_line.squads: Each squad owns its area, its budget and its answer.
model_line.matrix: Competence pools lend their people to the projects that need them.
model_line.circles: Roles, not titles: each circle holds its own decisions.
model_line.owner_network: Flat: one owner and one backup per topic.
model_line.taskforce: A borrowed team with a stated end.
model_line.market: Agents bid; the best offer under your price cap wins.

people.question: Who is part of it?
people.help: Everyone in this workspace, humans and agents.
people.empty: No member or agent in this workspace yet.

review.question: Your draft
review.name: Name
review.draft_note: Nothing is activated: the draft opens in the chart so you can adjust it.
review.replaces_existing: Opening the draft revises the current structure “{{name}}”.

wizard.transfer_hint: Transfer workspace items with a preview before importing.

support-lead.name: Support coordination
support-lead.mission: Own the queue and answer for the team.

front-line.name: Front line
front-line.mission: Answer incoming requests the day they arrive.

escalation.name: Escalation
escalation.mission: Take what the front line cannot close.

partner.name: Firm leadership
partner.mission: Answer for every file that leaves the firm.

intake.name: Intake
intake.mission: Open a file, gather what it needs, say what it will take.

review.name: Review
review.mission: Read every file before it goes out.

account.name: Client relations
account.mission: Hold the relationship and arbitrate what ships.

production.name: Production
production.mission: Turn a brief into the deliverable it asks for.

direction.name: Direction
direction.mission: Decide and answer for the team.

finance.name: Finance
finance.mission: Prepare every figure; a human signs it off.

research-lead.name: Research coordination
research-lead.mission: Choose the questions and answer for the conclusions.

research.name: Research
research.mission: Look for the answer and show the sources.

peer-review.name: Peer review
peer-review.mission: Check the sources before a conclusion is published.

team.name: Team
team.mission: Do the work the team was set up for.

activate.title: Activate the structure
activate.description: Review the operating model and estimates before activating routing. The attestation below is your manual declaration of testing.

pause.title: Pause the structure
pause.description: Routing stops until you resume. Issues already assigned keep their assignee.

dissolve.title: Dissolve the structure
dissolve.description: A dissolved structure stops acting and becomes read-only. This cannot be undone.

delete.title: Delete the structure
delete.description: Only drafts and dissolved structures can be deleted. Its revisions go with it.

project_section.none: No structure applies to this project.

issue_section.escalate_description: The structure sends it up the escalation edge. Say why.

canvas.no_selection: Pick a unit to open its record.
canvas.json_broken: The JSON below no longer parses; fix it to get the canvas back.

tester.placeholder: Write it the way a customer or a colleague would.
tester.example_1: My card was declined at checkout, three customers today already.
tester.example_2: Rotate the production database password before Friday.
tester.picker_description: Its title, description and labels fill the request.
tester.empty: Nothing tested yet. Write a request and run it against the chart above.
tester.blocked_consequence: the request will be escalated with its context; this unit will not carry it out.
tester.error_invalid: The definition on the canvas is not valid, so nothing was tested: {{error}}. Settle the problems listed beside the chart first.
tester.stale: The request or organization changed. Run the test again.

problem.unit_name_required: Every unit needs an id and a name.
problem.duplicate_unit_id: The id “{{id}}” is used by two units.
problem.taskforce_unit_model: “{{unit}}”: a task force is a structure, not a unit.
problem.hierarchy_roots: A hierarchy has exactly one unit reporting to nobody; there are {{count}}.
problem.autonomy_over_trust: “{{unit}}” grants {{autonomy}} but {{agent}}'s trust dial stops at {{trust}}.
problem.rule_of_two_unit: “{{unit}}” holds untrusted input, sensitive data and external effects at once: a human approval will be required.
problem.rule_of_two_edge: {{from}} → {{to}} cumulates the three exposures: a human approval will be required on that link.
problem.deciders_missing: “{{unit}}” has external effects: name who decides on {{classes}}.
problem.committee_termination: Committee “{{decision}}”: set a quorum between 1 and {{max}} and at least one round.
problem.committee_decision_missing: A committee has no decision type.
problem.market_price_cap: A market needs the human price cap.
problem.squads_needs_agents: “{{unit}}” runs as a squad: give it a squad or agent members.
problem.circles_needs_role: “{{unit}}” runs as circles: give it at least one role.

unit.title: Unit record
unit.name: Name
unit.own_mission_placeholder: What this unit is here to do.
unit.human_approval: A human approves before it acts

trust_level_hint.read_only: It reads and comments, never changing anything.
trust_level_hint.draft: It prepares a draft that a human finishes and sends.
trust_level_hint.approve_payload: It prepares the content; a human approves before it goes out.
trust_level_hint.auto: It acts alone, within the limits it was given.

capability_enforcement.instruction: Told to the agent, not technically enforced

visual.cycle: This reporting line would create a loop.

history.title: Revision {{n}}
history.description: Restore the definition and model as a new revision. Current status, owner, budget and dates are preserved. All current validation rules apply.
history.dirty: Save or discard your edits before restoring.
history.full_diff: Changed teams are summarized above. Open the full definitions to inspect responsibilities, relationships, rules and budgets.
history.sheet_hint: Every published version, newest first. Restoring publishes an old version as a new one.

catalog.includes: 3 agents with roles, 1 shared procedure, 1 project, 1 org chart, 1 starter task and 1 weekly review.
catalog.paused: Agents need a runtime connection. The organization stays in draft and the weekly review stays paused.
catalog.collisions: {{count}} name conflicts detected. New items will be renamed; existing items are preserved.
catalog.next: Review the created items below, connect your agents to runtimes, then open the structure to check it before activation.

descriptions.support: Triage requests, draft replies and review sensitive cases.
descriptions.product: Turn a brief into implementation and reviewed delivery.
descriptions.agency: Plan, draft and review with a consistent editorial voice.
descriptions.finance: Prepare decisions and check supporting evidence.
descriptions.research: Investigate, cross-check sources and synthesize findings.

workspace.title: The right role. The right team.
workspace.description: Give your organization a shape. Bring agents and people together, clarify responsibilities and move work forward.
workspace.add_description: Describe the need, choose how work flows and assign members.

coherence.empty_team: This team is empty. Add its first members.
coherence.quorum_block: Committee “{{name}}” requires {{quorum}} teams. Explicitly change its composition or quorum before deleting this team.
coherence.scope_taken: This scope already has an organization. Choose another project or edit the existing organization.
coherence.conflict: A newer revision exists. Your draft is preserved; compare the versions before saving it.
coherence.publish_hint: These changes will immediately affect routing in the active organization.
coherence.catalog_admin: Installing a template requires an administrator or owner role.

studio.empty_hint: Describe its mission, choose its members, then check where requests go.
studio.explicit_people: Nobody is added automatically. Choose only the people who will work in this organization.

edge_kind_effect.informational: Informational only, no effect on routing

simulate_note.no_rule_matched: No rule matched and the model has no fallback unit.
simulate_note.unit_no_owner: “{{unit}}” has no human owner, so it never receives work.
simulate_note.market_not_staged: This unit runs an internal market: the run goes to the best offer under the price cap, which a simulation does not stage.
simulate_note.approval_risk: The unit's superior approves first when the request's contract risk is {{risk}}.
simulate_note.no_spend_observed: No spend observed for this unit over the last {{days}} days.

escalations.title: Unit {{unit}} escalates too much
escalations.body: Add a backup member, split the unit, or widen its allow list so fewer issues go up.

vacant_roles.title: Roles vacant in {{unit}}
vacant_roles.body: Fill the roles or remove them: {{roles}}

saturated_agents.title: Agents saturated in {{unit}}
saturated_agents.body: Add capacity to the unit or route less to it.

budget_spent.title: Budget spent by {{unit}}
budget_spent.body: Raise the budget or pause the unit until next month.

unrouted.title: Issues without a resolvable owner
unrouted.body: Add routing rules (labels, paths, keywords) or a fallback unit.

drift.title: Measured flows drift from the declared structure
drift.body: Re-review the structure: humans reassign outside the units it routes to.

activation_requirement.termination: A declared termination for the task force, committee and market

plan.zoom_fit: Fit the chart to the window
plan.no_lead: No lead yet: escalations from this team have no one to reach.
plan.empty_hint: Add a first team, or start from a business template that brings its roles and its routing rules.

overview.vacant_role: Role with nobody in it: “{{role}}”, in {{unit}}.
overview.model_hint: Changing the model changes how work circulates through every team.
overview.committee_no_effect: A committee has no effect at run time today: the server only validates it.

health.empty: No request routed in the last 7 days. Test one to see the path it would take.

unit.remove_confirm: Click again to confirm — this cannot be undone.
unit.deciders_hint: Shown because this team is exposed to external effects.
unit.receives_none: No routing rule yet: this team only receives what is assigned by hand.
unit.capability_instruction_note: * An instruction given to the agent, not a technical block: no tool enforces it today.
unit.reports_to_none: Nobody — this is the top of the chart.

person.agent_autonomy_hint: An agent never has more rights than the team that hands it work.
person.owns_hint: Validates every draft from these teams.
